# Dangling Pages

If an entity that owns a page is removed without appropriately cleaning up the pages, there can be orphaned pages on disk that do not correspond to any current data entity, leading to outdated or misleading content in the documentation.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter._prune_orphaned_pages`
